name: MiniLinks v3 Favorite/Star Bookmarks Feature DAG Orchestration Plan

target_application.name: MiniLinks
target_application.description: Lightweight SQLite-backed bookmark manager with favorites/starring support

tasks.description: Update examples/minilinks/SPEC.md to specify the Bookmarks Favorite/Star feature. Define the is_favorite boolean attribute (stored as INTEGER DEFAULT 0 in SQLite, serialized as boolean in JSON payloads), update PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> contract to accept {'is_favorite': true/false}, update GET /api/bookmarks contract to support query parameter ?favorites=true to return only favorite bookmarks, and specify the frontend bookmark card star button (★/☆) toggle and filter bar favorites button.

Implement the is_favorite feature in the MiniLinks backend. In examples/minilinks/app/database.py: update SQLite schema to include 'is_favorite INTEGER DEFAULT 0' (with backward-compatible table migration adding the column via ALTER TABLE if missing), support favorites_only filter in get_all_bookmarks, support is_favorite in update_bookmark, and ensure row-to-dict returns 'is_favorite' as a Python boolean. In examples/minilinks/app/server.py: parse ?favorites=true in GET /api/bookmarks, parse is_favorite in PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id>, and ensure JSON response includes is_favorite.

Implement the favorite/star bookmark UI in examples/minilinks/web/. In index.html: add a 'Favorites' filter button or tab in the search/filter controls. In app.js: add a star/favorite toggle button (★ / ☆) to each rendered bookmark card that triggers a PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> with {'is_favorite': !current} and updates UI state; implement filtering by favorites when the Favorites filter is active. In style.css: add styling for the favorite toggle button and active star highlight color.

Add comprehensive test coverage for the is_favorite feature in examples/minilinks/tests/. In test_api.py: test that newly created bookmarks have is_favorite=False by default, test PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> toggling is_favorite to true and false, test GET /api/bookmarks?favorites=true returns only favorites, and test validation on invalid is_favorite values. In test_persistence.py: test that is_favorite status persists accurately across SQLite database server restarts.

Harden integration between backend, frontend, and tests. Update examples/minilinks/scripts/smoke_test.py to verify favorite toggling via PATCH and favorites filtering via GET /api/bookmarks?favorites=true in the deterministic smoke test. Fix any defects across app, web, tests, or scripts so all unit tests and the smoke test pass with zero errors.

Perform an independent, rigorous final audit of the complete MiniLinks favorite/star implementation across database schema, REST API contracts, static frontend UI, test suites, and smoke test against examples/minilinks/SPEC.md.
